title: A high-velocity SiO jet from S255N SMA3
question: Characterize the shape, velocity structure, and physical and kinematic properties of the SiO jet from S255N SMA3, and evaluate whether it is driven by a steady-state magneto-centrifugal disk wind or wide-angle entrainment-driven outflows.

data.sensitivity: Continuum: 0.16 mJy/beam; CS 5-4: 1.04 mJy/beam; SiO 5-4: 1.34 mJy/beam; SiO 6-5: 1.61 mJy/beam

recipe.goal: Fit 250 GHz continuum source properties and derive core/disk inclination and mass
recipe.method: Fit a 2D Gaussian profile to the 250 GHz continuum emission peak using CASA imfit; derive disk inclination from deconvolved axis ratio and compute dust and total gas+dust mass from integrated flux.
assumptions: Geometrically thin and circular protostellar disk for inclination lower limit
T_dust = 20 K, distance d = 1.78 kpc, gas-to-dust ratio = 100

recipe.goal: Construct moment maps, measure jet collimation, opening angle, inclination, de-projected velocity, length, and dynamical age
recipe.method: Create moment 0 and moment 1 maps over +- 5-60 km/s; measure collimation ratio from red lobe extent over largest width; measure jet opening angle from half-power contour of SiO 5-4 integrated intensity; average disk and flow inclinations; de-project velocity and length to compute dynamical age for SiO and CS.
key_parameters: Velocity range for moment maps: +- 5 to 60 km s^-1 relative to V_LSR = 7.8 km s^-1
assumptions: Azimuthal symmetry of the jet; opening angle is an upper limit on inclination angle; gas travelled at constant velocity since ejection

recipe.goal: Construct Position-Velocity (PV) diagrams along the jet axis and analyze episodic knots
recipe.method: Extract PV diagrams along the jet axis for SiO J=5-4 and J=6-5; identify triangular velocity morphology and periodic vertical stripes of emission peaks at 0.2 arcsec intervals to calculate de-projected knot separation, ejection timescale, and Keplerian disk radius.
key_parameters: PV contour levels: starting at 3 sigma in increments of 3 sigma; knot interval = 0.2 arcsec
assumptions: Keplerian disk rotation around a 0.7 M_sun protostar for translating periodicity timescale to disk radius

recipe.goal: Derive pixel-by-pixel SiO excitation temperature across the jet
recipe.method: Convert spectral cubes from Jy/beam to brightness temperature (K) using beam solid angle from radio_beam; mask both SiO cubes at 5 sigma and integrate over channels with signal; perform a two-level rotation diagram analysis on a pixel-by-pixel basis between SiO J=6-5 and J=5-4 to compute T_ex, and take the mean across the core of the two outflow lobes.
key_parameters: 5 sigma masking threshold for integrated intensity maps
assumptions: Local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE) and optically thin emission

recipe.goal: Derive outflow column densities, mass, momentum, kinetic energy, mass flow rate, force, and power
recipe.method: Mask SiO cubes at 3 sigma; calculate SiO column density per velocity channel using T_ex = 42 K and partition function; convert to H2 column density using SiO abundance of 10^-7; sum over pixels and velocity channels to compute mass, inclination-corrected momentum and kinetic energy, and divide by dynamical age (343 yr) for rates.
key_parameters: 3 sigma masking threshold; T_ex = 42 K; V_LSR = 7.8 km s^-1; inclination i = 48.6 +- 15 deg; dynamical age = 343 +- 181 yr
assumptions: Optically thin emission; LTE at T_ex = 42 K; SiO/H2 abundance = 10^-7; distance = 1.78 kpc
